sloka: तिष्ठतः किम् नु माम् दृष्ट्वा क्षुधा आर्तम् क्षत्रिय ऋषभौ ।आहार अर्थम् तु सन्दिष्टौ दैवेन गत चेतसौ ॥३-७०-२॥
transliteration: tiṣṭhataḥ kim nu mām dṛṣṭvā kṣudhā ārtam kṣatriya ṛṣabhau ।āhāra artham tu sandiṣṭau daivena gata cetasau ॥3-70-2॥

translations.english: O bulls among the kshatriyas You are sent by destiny as food to appease my hunger. Seeing me hungry, why do you stand there with your senses switched off ?
